name: YouTubeTranscriptAPI REST API
description:
Fetch YouTube transcripts, search YouTube, and list channel and playlist videos as JSON.

**Authentication.** Send an API key on every request: `Authorization: Bearer tk_live_…`. Create keys at https://youtubetranscriptapi.com/dashboard/keys.

**Credits.** Each operation's price is in its description and in `x-credit-cost`. Only successful (200) responses are charged; errors and rate-limited requests never are. Free operations still need a balance of at least 1 credit. Without enough credits you get 402 with a link to billing. Plans: https://youtubetranscriptapi.com/pricing.

**Errors.** Error bodies are `{ "detail": "…", "code": "…" }`. On 402 (`insufficient_credits`) `detail` is an object with the shortfall, a billing link and the plans; accounts without a plan also get `checkout_url`, a checkout that opens without signing in.

**Balance.** Successful responses carry X-Credits-Charged and X-Credits-Remaining. GET /account/whoami returns the plan and balance for free.

**Rate limits.** 300 requests per minute per API key by default, on a sliding one-minute window. Responses carry X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining and X-RateLimit-Reset; 429, 408 and 503 add Retry-After.

**Caching.** X-Cache-Status is HIT when a stored result was served and MISS otherwise. Stored responses cost the same as fresh ones.
